story.title: Story 2: Finalization Boundary Between Live State and Archive

result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on the prior execution-result identity blocker. I inspected the quick-fix in the execution hook, the real and in-memory history persistence paths, the new provider-history replay handling, the updated Story 2 server tests, and then reran the configured story and epic gates.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: `applyExecutionResultSideEffects` now passes the stored history row to `appendFromProcessHistoryItem` instead of the transient provider payload (`apps/platform/server/services/processes/environment/process-environment.service.ts:690-706`). Replay identity is preserved by storing/reusing `providerHistoryItemId` in both the in-memory store and Convex mutation (`apps/platform/server/services/projects/platform-store.ts:3158-3198`, `convex/processHistoryItems.ts:95-140`, `convex/schema.ts:36-40`). Updated TC-2.3a/TC-2.3b now assert archive identity against the persisted `storedHistoryItemId` and pass (`tests/service/server/archive-finalization.test.ts:200-295`). An ad hoc reproduction now yields one stored history row and one archive row keyed to the same persisted id across replays.

additionalObservations: An ad hoc runtime reproduction now returns the same stored history id on first and second execution-result replays, with `historyCount: 1`, `archiveCount: 1`, and the archive row keyed to the stored id rather than the provider id.

The replay fix is implemented as an internal `providerHistoryItemId` field/index on `processHistoryItems`; it is not exposed through the shared `ProcessHistoryItem` contract, so the live/archive separation remains an internal persistence concern.

Existing live/archive separation coverage still stands in `tests/service/server/process-live-updates.test.ts` and `tests/service/client/process-live.test.ts`, and I did not find a fake adapter, shim, or placeholder runtime branch in the touched production path.
